question: **Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank number 3.**
solution:
The correct answer is: **Experiencing**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Experiencing **refers to going through or encountering a particular situation, event, or feeling. (किसी विशेष स्थिति, घटना या भावना से गुजरना या उसका सामना करना)

 
 
• **Example**: *After years of studying marine life in books, the marine biologist was excited about experiencing the underwater world firsthand during the scuba diving expedition.*
 
 
 
• The word "**experiencing**" is used here to convey that the world is currently going through or facing the occurrence of flash floods. 

Thus, the correct answer is **option 4**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Chasing: **Pursuing or following something or someone with the intention of catching or reaching them. (किसी चीज़ या किसी व्यक्ति को पकड़ने या उस तक पहुँचने के इरादे से उसका पीछा करना या उसका पीछा करना)
 
• **Holding: **Grasping or keeping something with your hands. (किसी चीज़ को अपने हाथ से पकड़ना)
 
• **Seeing: **Perceiving with the eyes or observing visually. (आँखों से समझना या दृष्टि से देखना)
